violations.explanation: GestureDetector does not participate in focus traversal and does not respond to keyboard activation (Enter/Space). Keyboard and switch-access users cannot focus or activate this custom button. It also provides no visual focus indicator. Using ElevatedButton/InkWell or wrapping with FocusableActionDetector would provide focus and activation support.

The Semantics wrapper marks the widget as a button but does not declare enabled: true. Assistive technologies may therefore report the button as disabled or fail to convey its enabled state. A native Material button would expose this state automatically.
